correctness.rationale: Read complete RESULT.md, check_steiner.py and verification. Reconstructed incidence algebra MM^T=(r-1)I+J with r=(v-1)/(k-1)>k and b=vr/k, and the exact distances 1/2/3/4. On ker M the centered powered-distance eigenvalue is a((k-1)a-k), a=2^p, giving sharp upper cutoff p*=log_2(k/(k-1)) because b>v. The v-1 paired mean-zero sectors have explicit 2x2 H_p with strictly negative principal minors at p* for k>=3, and one zero eigenvector each at k=2; constant contrast C_p<0 at p*, with the proof inequality using beta=log_2(3/2). Strict lower negative type follows from Li–Weston and all t>0 strict Gaussian positivity from distinct squared-Euclidean points. Independently constructed complete pair design v=4 and AG(2,3) and verified shortest-path/centered endpoint eigenvalue signatures k=2 nullity 5 and k=3 nullity 3; these examples corroborate, not prove, universal exponent or all endpoint ranks.
